readings: For each circuits.country, average constructorStandings.points and constructorStandings.wins across all constructor standings records for races held in that country. For each country, subtract the unweighted average of the countries’ average wins from that country’s average wins.

For each circuits.country, first sum constructorStandings.points and constructorStandings.wins across constructors at each race held there, then average those race totals within the country. For each country, subtract the unweighted average of the countries’ average race win totals from that country’s average race win total.
queries:
WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
        AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM constructorStandings AS cs
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT
    country,
    avg_points,
    avg_wins,
    avg_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_difference
FROM country_averages

WITH race_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        r.raceId,
        SUM(cs.points) AS race_points,
        SUM(cs.wins) AS race_wins
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
    JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        AVG(race_points) AS avg_race_points,
        AVG(race_wins) AS avg_race_wins
    FROM race_totals
    GROUP BY country
)
SELECT
    country,
    avg_race_points,
    avg_race_wins,
    avg_race_wins - (SELECT AVG(avg_race_wins) FROM country_averages) AS centered_avg_race_wins
FROM country_averages
